title: European Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier confirms AI-assisted cyberattack on 19 November
content_md:
European Commission spokesperson Thomas Regnier confirmed on 19 November an "AI-assisted" cyberattack against the EU executive body. The captured text cuts off after that statement.

via Mastodon https://www.frandroid.com/culture-tech/3332053_paie-conges-soins-la-commission-europeenne-piratee-avec-un-outil-ia-en-acces-libre
exclude_reason: French repost of the already-covered European Commission AI-assisted attack; no new confirmed detail.
